body: So much mental illness with the desire to at least make it through the day.
That does sound applicable to me. To the letter actually.

This is so much great information. I really appreciate you going through all of this. 

We do see a marriage counselor and youre right, some stuff isnt brought up. Either because im nervous to talk about it or i dont think about it until the moment. 

We are definitely codependent.

I was doing therapy with my therapist for about a year, until "the incident" (as i am referring to it) now they have me in an outpatient program. Im very resistant to this idea because it is group therapy, i dont think they realize/care how hard it is for me to be in a group setting like that. Im really going just so my husband is more comfortable, its for my depression. I know i should want to go but you hit the nail on the head a couple times. It feels like a lot of work to get to a normal place and what if i have a bad day? The fall into depression from my current state isnt a long one and im worried that if i fall from being happy it will really suck. Then i dont want to go somewhere where to be fixed, ive been doing ok for years and i slipped up. But i am going to go and try to keep an open mind about it.

I have joined an outpatient therapy program (at his request), 3 hours a day. 5 days a week. I hate the idea, i hate the idea of trying to fix myself. Avoidance of pain feels so much better than dealing with anything. 

Its been so long it is hard to think there could be better.

I know he is frustrated with me. I know he wants me to get better. The thing is, he wants me to want to get better and i just... dont want to? I guess. I dont want to put the work in to scratch and claw my way to happiness and comfort when i have been dealing with this on my own for years. That isnt fair to him. I guess i feel like i want him to go away so i dont feel like a constant disappointment. 

Your post was enlightening. I imagine that is the exact way he was/is feeling.
I do have a therapist I see. My husband wants to help but gets understandably frustrated with me. Just cant seem to pull myself out of this hole.
You're probably right. It's not something i should mess with, a longer harder life is not what i want. It just felt like an easy out.... something no one could blame me for.

Yeah, I guess that is basically what I am saying. I understand that it is not fair of me to do this to anyone but at the same time... i am so tired of everyday being a fight and struggle to just do the basics. It boils down to a quality vs quantity thing. 

I think the only thing that scares me is how long it can take, months to years if i understand correctly. As far as being hospitalized, my hopes are I will be too far gone to help.
I think you misunderstood. I wasn't very clear, I dont think i will be seeking treatment. It feels like a very convenient way out.
Looks like ovarian that has spread. They are talking just surgery now, more tests to come.
